about: The app's name and identifiers. Visible names are templates filled from data/edition.json ({year}, {short}) and project.godot ({version}); tools/release/sync_identity.py writes them into project.godot and export_presets.cfg (--check fails when those files disagree), and the release tools and AppIdentity read them from here. user_dir and android_package are FROZEN and never follow the edition: user_dir is the save folder (%APPDATA%\<user_dir>, user:// on every platform), so renaming it would leave every existing install without its settings and study progress; android_package is the Android application id, and a different id installs as a separate app beside the old one instead of upgrading it in place. sync_identity.py only checks them. legacy_project_names are the names the project had while saves went to Godot's default folder (%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\<name>, before 1.0); UserDirMigration looks there, so later app renames cannot break that one-time copy.
